plan.scope: Native Linux physical runner. Same binary contains exact base/head adapters, chosen through a volatile pointer; identical-binary aliases. Three unmeasured batches then seven individually interleaved checked calls. Native arithmetic control omits VM admission/FP isolation, and is not an equivalent VM. C boundary diagnostic, not Go/LLGo/P3 throughput or full-profile acceptance. Fixed 20 blocks, no extension or pruning. No concurrent owned build/test/profile during measurement.

validation.macGo: Go1.27.3 native/codegen/nativeexec/VM passes .689/4.586/.365/.804s before diagnostic-only FP probe strengthening; full exact-head hosted matrix required
validation.linuxDocker: Exact-source focused FP environment/every-exit/callee-saved-register probes pass .058s; nativeexec/VM pass .235/.864s. Full native package could not run a huge-address reservation under Rosetta (allocation8000000000000000); codegen corpus path was not mounted. These are incomplete local outcomes; real Linux full CI remains required. No Docker timings are performance evidence.

limits: No Go/LLGo public-API or complete P3 speedup inferred from a C loop. O2 and O3-full-LTO are two C compiler profiles, not actual whole Go/LLGo binaries.
Guest arithmetic control has no admission, floating isolation, cancellation or VM contract; no direct-control ratio is an engine ranking.
All20 blocks retained; individual95% paired diagnostic intervals from20k seeded log-ratio bootstrap. No simultaneous or full-profile acceptance.
